games.headline: Powell scores 25 points to help the Bulls hold off the Bucks, 132-125
games.desc: — Norman Powell had 25 points, rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 and the Chicago Bulls beat the Milwaukee Bucks 132-125 on Friday.

games.headline: Jayson Tatum scores 36, sizzles down the stretch as Celtics fend off Knicks 107-103
games.desc: — Jayson Tatum scored 25 of his 36 points in the second half, including seven of his team’s final eight to help the Boston Celtics hold off the New York Knicks 107-103 on Friday night.

games.headline: Hornets blown out by Hawks 128-81 in first game home without LaMelo Ball, booed by sellout crowd
games.desc: — Jalen Johnson had 19 points, eight assists and seven rebounds and Atlanta hammered the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday night in the Hawks' largest blowout in franchise history.

games.headline: Mavericks lose Flagg to injury, and ruin Haliburton's home return with 121-105 win over Pacers
games.desc: — Kyrie Irving scored 24 points and the Dallas Mavericks overcame the loss of Cooper Flagg to spoil Tyrese Haliburton 's home return for the Indiana Pacers in a 121-105 victory Friday...

games.headline: Despite low output from Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves dominate glass and roll Magic 115-93
games.desc: — Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels each scored 15 points to help the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Orlando Magic 115-93 on Friday night.

games.headline: Barnes, Barrett pace stingy Raptors to a 112-102 win over the Wizards
games.desc: — Scottie Barnes had 28 points and 14 rebounds, and the Toronto Raptors continued their stellar defensive start to the season with a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday night.

games.headline: Pistons roll past Heat 128-111, adding to Miami's season-opening woes on defensive end
games.desc: — John Collins scored 23 points, Paul Reed added 19 off the bench and the Detroit Pistons added to Miami's season-opening defensive misery by beating the Heat 128-111 on Friday night.

games.headline: Amen Thompson blocks Wembanyama in final second as the Rockets beat the Spurs 114-110 in Austin
games.desc: — Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama's game-tying layup attempt with less than a second remaining and the Houston Rockets held on to beat the San Antonio Spurs 114-110 on Friday night.

games.headline: Jackson scores 24 and Peterson makes go-ahead FTs to lift Jazz over Pelicans
games.desc: — Jaren Jackson Jr. had 24 points and 10 rebounds, rookie Darryn Peterson made the go-ahead free throws with 50.5 second left, and the Utah Jazz outlasted the New Orleans Pelicans 120-119 on Friday night.

games.headline: Cameron Boozer hits go-ahead jumper with 20 seconds left, Grizzlies rally to beat Warriors 111-108
games.desc: — Cameron Boozer made a go-ahead jumper with 20 seconds left and finished with 25 points and 13 rebounds, and the Memphis Grizzlies came from 12 points down over the final 3:47 to beat the Golden State Warriors 111-108 on Friday night.

games.headline: Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler lead Lakers past Clippers 125-117 for 2nd win to start season
games.desc: — Austin Reaves had 28 points and nine assists, Walker Kessler added 22 points and six blocked shots, and the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Los Angeles Clippers 125-117 on Friday night for their second win to start the season.

games.headline: Deni Avdija scores 26 points to lead Trail Blazers in win over Kings
games.desc: — Deni Avdija led the Trail Blazers with 26 points, six rebounds, and six assists in the Portland Trail Blazers 128-120 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Friday.
